entries.text: Could you please repeat that?
entries.easy_read:
I did not hear.
I ask again.

entries.text: Sorry, I did not hear that.
entries.easy_read:
I did not hear you.
I say sorry.

entries.text: Could you speak a little more slowly, please?
entries.easy_read:
You talk fast.
Please talk slowly.

entries.text: I did not understand that. Could you explain it again?
entries.easy_read:
I do not understand.
Please tell me again.

entries.text: Could you write that down for me, please?
entries.easy_read:
Please write it for me.
Then I can read it.

entries.text: Could you show me how to do it?
entries.easy_read:
Please show me.
Then I can do it.

entries.text: So I should finish this box first. Is that right?
entries.easy_read:
I say what I heard.
I ask if it is right.
hints: Then ask if it is right

entries.text: Sorry, which one do you mean?
entries.easy_read:
There are many.
I ask which one.

entries.text: One more time, please.
entries.easy_read: Please say it again.

entries.text: Could you spell that for me, please?
entries.easy_read:
I do not know that word.
Please say each letter.

entries.text: I caught the first part but not the last part.
entries.easy_read:
I heard the start.
I did not hear the end.

entries.text: Just to be sure, you want this done today?
entries.easy_read:
I want to be sure.
You want it today.
Is that right?

entries.text: Could you face me when you speak? It helps me understand.
entries.easy_read:
Please look at me.
Then I can understand you.

entries.text: It is very noisy here. Could we talk somewhere quieter?
entries.easy_read:
It is loud here.
Can we go somewhere quiet?

entries.text: What does that word mean?
entries.easy_read:
I do not know that word.
I ask what it means.

entries.text: Give me a moment to think, please.
entries.easy_read:
I need to think.
Please wait a little.

entries.text: Could you send me the instructions in writing?
entries.easy_read:
Please send me a message.
Then I can read the steps.

entries.text: Could you point to the one you mean?
entries.easy_read:
I am not sure which one.
Please show me with your hand.

entries.text: Could you tell me the steps one at a time?
entries.easy_read:
Too many steps at once.
Please tell me one step.
Then the next step.

entries.text: Before I start, may I check one thing with you?
entries.easy_read:
I want to ask first.
Then I will start work.
